python tools/matter/tests/test_pase_exchange_chip.py --help; disposable Linux node, selected IPv6/interface, development credentials/PAA and unmodified chip-tool; run Memcheck then separate sanitizers. --tamper-pase injects bad MICs for TC-SC-2.2. --pase-errors checks TC-SC-2.3 invalid passcodeID/cA, required failure statuses, late-message rejection and fresh commissioning. Missing statuses remain conformance/overall FAIL even when functional recovery passes. --mrp-size checks TC-SC-1.1 complete IPv6 MTU1280: UDP payloads1231/1232 accepted,1233/1280/1281 silent, then fresh commissioning/CASE. --mrp-flows uses Python cryptography plus existing pase-vector.py affine test primitives for reliable PASE, piggyback/duplicate ACKs and five encrypted R0 reads bracketed by successful R1 controls. Missing data replies remain overall FAIL; keys never exported. Raw state stays private.

python tools/matter/tests/test_commissionable_announcement_chip.py --help; disposable Linux node, C payload utility, development PAA/credentials and unmodified chip-tool; --extended-discovery-seconds unlimited, 0 and 8 under Memcheck, then separately with a sanitizer node. Functional success never waives conformance failures.
